label: Bhoomi-LLM v1 (experimental, checkpoint-160) - local evaluation runtime

runtime.converted_with: llama.cpp convert_lora_to_gguf.py (master 23b0202), --outtype f16, base config only

known_differences_from_training: Base weights are Ollama's Q4_K_M GGUF of Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, NOT the pinned bf16 revision cdbee75f; upstream revision of the Ollama build is not recorded in its manifest
Adapter was trained on an nf4-quantised base; here it is applied at runtime to a Q4_K_M base (different quantisation error, untested)
LoRA weights are converted to f16 (training used fp32 LoRA weights)
Stage-1 development results were produced with the bf16 base + adapter, not with this runtime
